insights_trends_description: Counted from source timestamps and Luma’s records. Select a bar or table value to see the exact records behind it.
insights_orders_description: Orders by the day their source reports them placed, colored by their current status. An order linked across sources counts once.
insights_orders_limit: Colors show today’s status, not the status on the day the order was placed. Totals count orders, not revenue.
insights_orders_empty: The sources in this view report no orders placed in this period.
insights_fulfillment_description: Open fulfillment work by time since its source last reported progress. Each item counts under its first matching signal: on hold, past its fulfill-by date, or no progress for 48 hours.
insights_fulfillment_limit: Shows today’s backlog only. Luma didn’t record earlier backlogs. Work reported by two systems counts once in each.
insights_fulfillment_amount: {count, plural, one {{value} open fulfillment} other {{value} open fulfillments}}
insights_fulfillment_empty: No open fulfillment work right now.
insights_stock_description: Stock positions with an active replenishment rule, compared with the rule’s minimum. Stock counts only if it was read from its source in the last 5 minutes.
insights_stock_limit: A recorded purchase order doesn’t mean the supplier confirmed it or that enough stock is on its way. Positions without a rule aren’t counted.
insights_stock_unavailable_body: No position has an active replenishment rule, so stock risk is unknown, not zero.
insights_stock_empty: No positions with an active rule right now.
insights_cases_description: Issues by kind and the day Luma first detected them. A reopened issue stays on the day it was first detected.
insights_cases_limit: Counts the issues Luma detected, not every problem in your connected systems.
insights_cases_empty: Luma detected no issues in this period.
insights_procurement_description: Purchase orders that aren’t closed or canceled, by the stage their evidence supports. Overdue means the supplier’s confirmation or delivery is late.
insights_procurement_limit: Received means a goods receipt was booked in the purchasing system. Stages don’t reflect prices or savings.
insights_procurement_amount: {count, plural, one {{value} purchase order} other {{value} purchase orders}}
insights_procurement_unavailable_title: Purchase orders can’t be counted yet
insights_procurement_empty: No open purchase orders right now.
insights_unavailable_body: No connected source in this view reports these records, so the count is unknown, not zero.
insights_note_partial_history: Incomplete: starts before the imported history
insights_note_not_imported: Not imported: this period is before the imported history, so its count is unknown.
insights_source_not_synced_detail: no complete import yet, so records may be missing
insights_excluded_no_placed_time: {count, plural, one {{count, number} order without a placed time isn’t shown.} other {{count, number} orders without a placed time aren’t shown.}}
insights_excluded_no_detection_time: {count, plural, one {{count, number} issue without a detection time isn’t shown.} other {{count, number} issues without a detection time aren’t shown.}}
insights_excluded_other_class: {count, plural, one {{count, number} issue of another kind isn’t shown.} other {{count, number} issues of other kinds aren’t shown.}}
insights_excluded_other: {count, plural, one {{count, number} record can’t be placed on this chart.} other {{count, number} records can’t be placed on this chart.}}
insights_data_through_positions_missing: Some positions have no current stock reading
insights_data_through_unknown: Data through unknown: not every source has finished an import
insights_data_through_no_source: No source can report these records
insights_error_access_body: Sign in again or ask an owner for access to see this chart.
insights_error_outdated_body: This chart couldn’t be loaded with the current settings. Reload the page and try again.
insights_error_preparing_body: Luma is rebuilding the order list after an update. Try again in a few minutes.
insights_error_unavailable_body: Luma couldn’t load this chart. Earlier values are hidden so they aren’t mistaken for current ones.
insights_coverage_current: Current state only. Past states aren’t reconstructed.
insights_coverage_own_records: Luma’s own records. The source filter doesn’t apply.
insights_records_error_outdated: This chart was loaded more than 15 minutes ago. Refresh it to list the records it counted.
insights_records_error_access: Your access to this workspace changed. Sign in again or ask an owner for access.
insights_records_error_failed: Luma couldn’t load these records. Refresh the chart and try again.
insights_records_changed: Records changed after the chart was loaded. Refresh the chart to count them again.
insights_record_last_source_update: No progress reported, last source update {time}
insights_record_purchase_orders: {count, plural, one {{count, number} purchase order recorded} other {{count, number} purchase orders recorded}}
insights_record_items_to_answer: {count, plural, one {{count, number} item to answer} other {{count, number} items to answer}}
insights_unknown_reason_missing: No stock reading from the rule’s source
insights_unknown_reason_nonnumeric: The source quantity isn’t a number
insights_unknown_reason_future: Reading time is in the future
insights_unknown_reason_expired: Last reading is more than 5 minutes old
